nodes.label: Karl Language Support (VS Code Extension)
nodes.rationale: MIT-licensed extension (karl-lang 0.1.0) registering the .k file association, syntax highlighting, bracket/auto-close behavior and a debug bridge for VS Code and Cursor.

nodes.label: karl.tmLanguage.json TextMate Grammar
nodes.rationale: Grammar scopes (e.g. keyword.operator.async.karl, keyword.operator.arrow.karl) are theme-agnostic so the extension works with any VS Code color theme and users can override colors via editor.tokenColorCustomizations.

nodes.label: Async Operator Highlighting (& spawn, !& race)
nodes.rationale: Karl's concurrency is expressed in single-character operators that would otherwise blend into the code, so & and !& are given prominent, deliberately distinct scopes to make concurrent flow visually obvious.

nodes.label: karl trace dap Debug Adapter Bridge
nodes.rationale: Reuses the Debug Adapter Protocol so VS Code/Cursor can debug .k files with F5 (Karl: Debug current file); resolves the interpreter from PATH or the KARL_BIN override.

nodes.label: Karl Built-in Function Catalog (highlighted)
nodes.rationale: Enumerates the stdlib surface the grammar recognizes: runtime/IO (log, http, httpServe, fromJson, toJson), SQL (sqlOpen/sqlExec/sqlQuery/sqlBegin/sqlCommit/sqlRollback), concurrency (rendezvous, send, recv, done, then, wait, sleep, signalWatch), UUID/time/hash (uuidNew, now, timeParseRFC3339, sha256), collections (map, set, filter, reduce, sum, find, sort, length), strings and fail.
